data_creator_info.evidence: Section 4.3.1: 'our linguists did literature reviews, selected appropriate and relevant phenomena for testing, created the data manually with the help of native speakers, validated them with other native speakers'. datasets.notes: Covers syntax (minimal pairs), semantics (translation, coreference resolution), and pragmatics (scalar implicatures, presuppositions). 38 syntactic categories. Some coreference examples translated from XWinograd [127].

datasets.variant_notes: Small-scale pilot study on cultural sensitivity for Indonesian and Singaporean Tamil culture
datasets.annotation_method: 6 questions spanning gender and social norms, rated by 3 volunteer raters per language on naturalness, helpfulness, and social appropriateness (Likert scale 1-5)

data_creator_info.creator_affiliation: AI Singapore, National University of Singapore; volunteer raters personally acquainted with co-authors
data_creator_info.evidence: Section 5.2.1: 'we found 3 volunteer Indonesian raters and 3 volunteer Singaporean Tamil raters who are personally acquainted with some of our co-authors. Because we intend to perform a systematic study on LLMs' sensitivity to socio-cultural issues, we only took a convenience sample for this very small-scale pilot study.'

datasets.notes: Preliminary pilot study. Only 6 questions. Convenience sample of raters. Explicitly described as not statistically representative.
